nameAndMeaning.title: Nombre y significado
nameAndMeaning.content: Suparinpei (壱百零八手) means "108 hands/techniques". The Japanese name is built from 壱 (100), 百 (100), 零 (0), 八 (8) and 手 (hand) – which together indicates 108. In Chinese, the kata had a different name ("Pechurin" or similar) which may indicate a homonym. 108 is a sacred Buddhist number (think of the 108 powers of Yue Fei's Eagle Claw). Sometimes Suparinpei is translated as "108 steps", but actually it's about the number 108 in the kata.
